name: Fish-sauce houses
nameVi: Làng nghề nước mắm Phú Quốc
kicker: Wooden vats of Phú Quốc fish sauce
summary: Barrel house: walk the wooden vats where Phú Quốc fish sauce ages for about a year. The vats are about 3 m across and hold 14–17 tons. Yearly output is over 10 million litres, and also about 6 million litres. Nitrogen runs 20–43 gN/lít. Go in the morning and pair the stop with a pepper garden.
getThere: The old houses sat by the Dương Đông river
heroCaption: Red wooden vats in a Phú Quốc fish-sauce house, with light at the far door
body: Walk a barrel house and look down the rows of wooden vats. The craft is over 200 years old. The first draw comes after about a year. The vats are 3 m across and hold 14–17 tons. The salt ratio is 3 tons of fish to 1 ton of salt, and also 2.5–3 fish to 1 salt. The catch season is April–November, when the anchovy schools come inshore. One workshop ages cá cơm than for 15 months to 43 percent nitrogen. Output is over 10 million litres a year from about 100 producers, and also about 6 million litres. The old pattern was family houses along the Dương Đông river so boats could land.

The sauce is a dark cockroach-wing colour, salty and deeply sweet. Nitrogen is trên 25ºC across the district, 43 percent at one workshop, and 20–43 gN/lít, with readings up to 40°N. Age is about a year, 12 months, or 15 months at that workshop. Fermenting and bottling happen inside the old huyện Phú Quốc, with fish from the Gulf of Thailand. National geographical indication came in 2001, and European protection on 8 October 2012. A house name is a workshop. The visit is the vats.

figures.caption: Unpainted wooden vats bound with rope in a Phú Quốc barrel house
figures.alt: Rows of wooden fish-sauce vats bound with rope on Phu Quoc

gettingThere: The old houses sat along the Dương Đông river so boats could land. Ask in Dương Đông for a barrel house that lets you walk the vats, and keep the morning free so the pepper garden can follow.

legs.heading: From Dương Đông
legs.body: The historical houses were on the river in town. Pair the vats with a pepper garden on the same morning.

admissionNote: Nitrogen: 43 percent at one workshop, trên 25ºC across the district, and 20–43 gN/lít, with readings up to 40°N. Output is over 10 million litres a year and about 6 million litres a year.
